posts.title: The Great Silence (Il grande silenzio)
posts.synopsis: Utah, 1898. Bounty killers hound a small community into the mountains. When their cruel leader, Loco, murders Pauline’s refugee husband, the widow hires a mute gunman named Silence to lead the townspeople in revenge. But as the men face off, the line between right and wrong grows harder to make out.
pluses: Scenery is amazing, even if you won't like the movie this version of Utah is like eye candy

posts.title: The Cell
posts.synopsis: An FBI agent persuades a social worker, who is adept with a new experimental technology, to enter the mind of a comatose serial killer in order to learn where he has hidden his latest kidnap victim.
pluses: The way the killer's mind is displayed is simply amazing.
Costume and set design are A+
minuses: Casting doesn't match the vibe the movie gives
It could have been so much more if more emphasis had been placed on the mind of the murderer instead of rescuing the girl.

posts.title: Marty Supreme
posts.synopsis: Marty Mauser, a young man with a dream no one respects, goes to hell and back in pursuit of greatness.
pluses: Daniel Lopatin's synth-heavy score gives the 1950s setting a disorienting, propulsive '80s energy that fits Safdie's frantic style
minuses: Marty is such a mean-spirited, self-serving character that watching him steamroll everyone around him grows exhausting rather than compelling. Can also be viewed as a plus

posts.title: Chungking Express
posts.synopsis: In Hong Kong, two lovelorn and lonely police officers cross paths with two mysterious women. Cop 223 falls for a mysterious woman in a blonde wig, not knowing she is a big-time heroin smuggler. Meanwhile, Cop 663 visits a late-night diner, and the new server becomes secretly infatuated with him.
pluses: Wong Kar-wai builds two loosely connected stories around loneliness and longing in Hong Kong, and the film trusts atmosphere, music, and texture to carry meaning rather than tight narrative logic.
minuses: The two halves don't really talk to each other. Which can be hard to accept

posts.title: Death in Venice
posts.synopsis: Composer Gustav von Aschenbach travels to Venice for health reasons. There, he becomes obsessed with the stunning beauty of an adolescent Polish boy named Tadzio who is staying with his family at the same Grand Hôtel des Bains on the Lido as Aschenbach.
pluses: As a viewer you get sucked in the main emotions of the movie
minuses: The main topic of the movie is controversial nowadays

posts.title: I Am Not Your Negro
posts.synopsis: Based on Baldwin's unfinished manuscript Remember This House - a stirring, personal account of the lives and deaths of his friends Medgar Evers, Malcolm X and Martin Luther King Jr. - acclaimed director Raoul Peck creates a meditation on what it means to be Black in the United States, using meticulously assembled archival footage and driven by stirring voiceover narration from Samuel L. Jackson.
pluses: James Baldwin's words are as relevant today as they were when he first wrote them
Baldwin and his use of words are candy to the ears
